Everyone is the CEO of their own life.

If this is the first time you've heard that, congratulations. Why?

Because for the first time in history, anyone — any CEO — can hire AI consultants to strengthen their Board of Directors, for free.

My name is Ricky Saif. Since 2013, I've been helping organizations transform. Today, I help professionals, founders, and high-agency individuals navigate life more strategically with AI.

It starts with a mental model I created called My Self, Inc.

Here’s the foundation:

  • You, as an individual, are a company.
  • You, as consciousness, are the CEO.
  • Your money is the treasury.
  • Your body is the company’s tangible assets: machines, buildings, vehicles.
  • Your emotions are the employees moving those assets.

That alone already explains a lot about life.

But here’s the core idea of My Self, Inc:

The CEO does not directly manage the employees. The Board of Directors does.

Those directors are the voices in your head.

Some are strong. Some are weak. Some you listen to. Some you ignore.

My Self, Inc. — A Mental Model for a Better Life

Now close your eyes for a moment.

What does a beautiful life look like to you?

A beautiful life is when the voices in your head are active, aligned, and working together — enabling your emotions to move your body toward the life you truly want.

The more aligned those voices are, the more efficient your life becomes.

You, the CEO, define the company’s identity and vision:

  • Who are you?
  • How do you want to live?
  • How do you want to die?

The clearer your identity and vision become, the easier it is to align your Board of Directors.

Thankfully, the board is dynamic — not fixed.

Now imagine the opposite.

An ugly life is when the voices in your head work against each other. Some directors are silent. Others are in conflict.

Your emotions pull your body in different directions.

You feel trapped in a life that doesn’t feel like yours, yet you don’t know how to change it.

Your identity feels fake. Your vision feels empty.

Now Imagine AI Consultants for Your Board

Imagine your Board of Directors gaining access to actionable wisdom from the greatest minds in history.

They become stronger.

And this matters because emotions are loud, irrational, and impulsive.

A weak Board cannot manage them.

Without strong directors, emotions sabotage the CEO. They take over operations. One weak director can destabilize the entire company.

That’s why every part of the Board matters.

So How Does This Actually Work?

Simple.

Your Board reports the situation. The AI consultant gives advice.

If the advice is rational, execute it.

If it’s not, challenge it until it becomes rational.

The day-to-day operation is easy.

The hard part is the initial setup.

To give truly useful advice, the AI consultant needs context — your context.

That’s why even twins require different guidance.

And that’s why I can’t give you truly personalized advice on a webpage alone.
